solves.reason: drugs undergo extensive studies→(A)extensive; FDA does not evaluate supplements→(B)evaluate; objective is to ensure consumers→(C)ensure
FDA gives formal premarket approval→(A)approval; legislators want to improve the law→(B)improve; potentially serious side effects→(C)side effects
cure, mitigate, treat(완화)→(A)mitigate; subsequently shown to be dangerous→(B)subsequently; put on shelves→(C)shelves
③ 'expanded authority' = 본문은 limited(제한된) authority. expanded는 부적절
② 'remove safe supplements' = 본문은 unsafe supplements를 제거해야 함. safe는 부적절
④ 'consumers can blur the difference' = tell(구분하다)이 맞음. blur(흐리다)는 부적절
FDA gives formal premarket approval to a drug
some legislators in Congress who want to improve the law
diagnose, cure, mitigate(완화하다), treat, or prevent disease
extensive = comprehensive(광범위한, 포괄적인)
monitors = oversees(감독하다)
improve = enhance(향상시키다)
dangerous(위험한)의 반의어 = harmless(무해한)
requiring(요구하다)의 반의어 = exempting(면제하다)
(A) drug treats disease = 치료하다. (B) treat colleagues to dinner = 대접하다
dietary ingredient intended to add nutritional value = supplement(보충제)
studies of (effective) → 명사형 effectiveness
those that have (potential) serious side effects → 부사형 potentially
FDA only limited authority over supplements
consumers can tell the difference between dietary supplements that are safe and those that have side effects
